note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997) (Synhamitermes quadriceps (Wasmann), Figs. 46, 47, 48A), originally in English; the four synonym combinations, the chronological bibliography, the figure numbers and the distribution records are not translated. The short diameter of the alate ocellus is given in the original as “0.05-0.75”, clearly an OCR error, and the figures are left unchanged; the parenthetical remark “the type material has been examined” in the soldier section is as recorded in the original work.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; postclypeus pale yellow; antennae and labrum paler than the postclypeus; pronotum paler than the head, with a weak T-shaped pale marking; abdomen paler than the pronotum. Head and body densely covered with a layer of fine hairs and several longer hairs. Total length (with wings) 8.85–10.40 mm, (without wings) 4.5–5.2 mm. Head nearly square, length to the mandibular base 0.55–0.75 mm, width including the eyes 0.80–0.94 mm; Y-shaped suture absent. Fontanelle small, subcircular, situated a little behind the middle of the head. Compound eyes subcircular, medium in size (diameter 0.20–0.27 mm). Ocelli oval, oblique, the distance from the compound eye less than half their long diameter (long diameter 0.08–0.14 mm, short diameter 0.05–0.75 mm, eye–ocellus distance 0.03–0.05 mm). Antennae 14–15-segmented; segment 3 shortest and thinnest; segments 4 and 5 about equal in length. Postclypeus raised, crescent-shaped, setose, about half as long as wide; anteclypeus glabrous, trapezoidal, slightly projecting at the middle. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, slightly narrower than the head width including the eyes (length 0.43–0.61 mm, width 0.64–0.80 mm). Wings pale brown, with hairs on the margins, the membrane sparsely covered with fine hairs; microsculpture and venation as in the genus. Forewing length 7.3–8.2 mm, hindwing length 7.0–8.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (The type material has been examined.) Head pale yellow to brownish yellow; antennae slightly paler than the head; mandibles reddish brown to dark brown, paler at the base; pronotum cream yellow; legs and abdomen greyish white to pale yellow. Head sparsely setose, the body vestiture moderately dense. Head capsule nearly square, slightly longer than wide (length to the mandibular base 0.84–1.0 mm, maximum width 0.69–0.85 mm); Y-shaped suture absent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus semicircular, distinctly delimited from the frons, with a pair of setae on the anterior margin; anteclypeus thin, band-like, glabrous. Labrum broadly lingulate (triangular with a narrow apex in the type material, perhaps shrunken from being glued to a card). Mandibles short and stout, 0.57–0.67 mm long; the outer margin incurved at the middle; each mandible with a triangular tooth near the middle of the inner margin. Postmentum short, rod-shaped, the waist strongly incurved (length 0.52–0.62 mm, maximum width 0.23–0.29 mm, width at the waist 0.16–0.20 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; the anterior margin without a notch, the posterior margin nearly straight or indistinctly incurved at the middle (length 0.24–0.35 mm, maximum width 0.48–0.55 mm). Mesonotum as wide as the pronotum, metanotum slightly wider than the pronotum; neither with a posterior notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to pale brown; antennae, legs and thorax pale yellow; abdomen dirty white owing to the gut contents. Head and body rather densely hairy. Total length 3.0–4.20 mm. Head nearly square, the sides and posterior margin weakly rounded (length to the labral apex 0.90–1.03 mm, length to the mandibular base 0.60–0.73 mm, maximum width 0.70–0.83 mm). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest, slightly shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus raised, less than half as long as wide (length 0.15–0.20 mm, width 0.35–0.38 mm). Labrum nearly square, setose. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.22–0.35 mm, width 0.40–0.50 mm); neither the anterior nor the posterior margin notched.
